findings.title: Migration crashes with NoMethodError when embed_category or uncategorized_category_id is not in site_settings
findings.body: In `CreateEmbeddableHosts#change`, `execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories AS c INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` assumes the query returns at least one row. On any database where `embed_category` was never modified from its default (or does not match a category name), `execute(...)[0]` returns `nil` and calling `['id']` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method '[]' for nil:NilClass`, aborting the migration. The fallback query on line 15 (`SELECT value FROM site_settings WHERE name = 'uncategorized_category_id'`) has the exact same problem if `uncategorized_category_id` is not stored in `site_settings`. Check `result.cmd_tuples > 0` before indexing into `result[0]`.

findings.title: Migrated embeddable_hosts values are not normalized and are interpolated directly into SQL
findings.body: Previously, `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` allowed entries with schemes or paths (e.g. `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`), whereas `EmbeddableHost` strips `^https?://` and `/.*$` in `before_validation` and `record_for_host` compares `lower(host) = uri.host`. Because the migration inserts raw lines via `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` without stripping the scheme/path (or quoting `h`), any existing host entry that included `http://`, `https://`, or a path will stop matching in `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` after the migration, and any single quote in the setting will break the SQL statement.

findings.title: before_validation raises NoMethodError when host is nil and does not match non-lowercase URLs
findings.body: In `EmbeddableHost`, the `before_validation` callback calls `self.host.sub!(...)` unconditionally. If `EmbeddableHost.new` is validated with `host: nil` (for example via missing params or in tests/console), `nil.sub!` raises `NoMethodError` instead of adding a validation error. Additionally, `record_for_host` queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` where `host = URI(url).host`; if the passed URL has an uppercase hostname (e.g. `http://EvilTrout.com/foo`), `uri.host` preserves case (`"EvilTrout.com"`), so comparing `lower(host)` against a non-downcased `host` parameter will fail to match.

findings.title: EmbeddableHost.record_for_host ignores ports even though validation allows them
findings.body: `EmbeddableHost` validates `:host` with a regex that explicitly permits `:port` (e.g. `example.com:8080`), and `before_validation` preserves the port in `self.host`. However, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` against `uri.host`, which strips the port. As a result, any `EmbeddableHost` saved with a port will never be matched by `record_for_host` or `host_allowed?`.

findings.title: String.prototype.replace('_', '-') only replaces the first underscore
findings.body: In `basePath`, `type.replace('_', '-')` only replaces the first underscore in `type`. If an admin model name has more than one underscore (e.g. `site_customization_something`), only the first underscore is converted and the lookup in `ADMIN_MODELS` fails. Use `type.replace(/_/g, '-')` (or `Ember.String.dasherize(type)`).

findings.title: Contents of category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb are swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was replaced with `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)` while `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains the `:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category`, and `:private_category` fabricators. The two files have their contents reversed.

findings.title: Spec 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' no longer tests what it claims
findings.body: `Topic#expandable_first_post?` was changed to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` and no longer checks `EmbeddableHost`. In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb`, the test `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` now runs before `SiteSetting.embed_truncate = true` and `topic.stubs(:has_topic_embed?).returns(true)` are set up, so it passes only because `embed_truncate` defaults to `false`, not because `embeddable_host` is blank.
